votes.motion: Approve the request from Cosimi Corporation, d/b/a The Bootlegger, for a change of license/alteration of premises at 50 Massachusetts Avenue.
votes.quote: ernie motioned to approve the request, steve seconded, voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Reschedule the Centre Pizza request to transfer its beer & wine license to a new lessee to December 13, 2011, at the request of the applicant.
votes.quote: paula move to reschedule to december 13, 2011 at request of applicant, steve seconded, voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Appoint Brent Benson to the Lunenburg Cultural Council.
votes.quote: paula move to appoint mr. benson to cultural council, steve seconded, voted unanimously to approve.

votes.motion: Make the FY12 budget adjustments as recommended by the Town Manager (including directing the $26,485 balance to the Salary Reserve Account).
votes.quote: paula motion to make the adjustments as recommended by the town manager, steve seconded, voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Nominate Paula to run for the Sub-Region Representative position on the Metropolitan Planning Organization (MPO).
votes.quote: dave nominated paula to run for this position, ernie seconded, paula is willing to serve, voted unanimously to approve the nomination of paula.
